info.title: Vikunja (fleet-todo scope, READ-ONLY)
info.description: Hand-authored OpenAPI subset of the Vikunja REST API (go-vikunja 2.8.0), scoped to read-only access over the agent fleet's 'Fleet Todos' project: list/get projects, list/get tasks within a project, get a single task, and list labels. Deliberately excludes every create/update/delete operation (no POST/PUT/DELETE paths are declared) so this bridge cannot mutate the fleet todo store — mutation stays on the laptop `_shared/vikunja.py` curl path under the `fleet` user's full token scope. Authentication is a static Authorization: Bearer <token> header injected by the openapi-mcp bridge (not declared here) using the same `fleet_token` the laptop helper uses.

tags.name: project
tags.description: Vikunja projects (the fleet uses one shared 'Fleet Todos' project)

tags.name: task
tags.description: Tasks within a project, each labelled with an owning persona

tags.name: label
tags.description: Labels (one per owning persona, per the fleet todo contract)

get.summary: List projects. Use this to find the 'Fleet Todos' project id by title match.
List tasks in a project (paginated). Each task carries `labels[]` (the owning persona's label) and `done`/`due_date`/`priority`. This is the fleet todo backlog read path.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Vikunja filter expression, e.g. done = false

get.summary: Get one task by id (full detail incl. description, labels, due_date, priority, done).
List labels. The fleet convention is one label per owning persona plus `robert-action`.
